dataList.content:
One night in Hongyuan, brightly lit under its artificial light.
即使到了晚上，在人造光源下依然明亮的鸿园之夜。

The child's yellow eyes glimmer menacingly in the shadows as she stares down at the thief.
孩子黄色的眼睛炯炯有神地闪烁着，俯视着眼前可恶的小偷。

Done running? It was embarrassing to watch.
你那可笑的狂奔终于结束了吗。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

???
？？？
dataList.content:
I knew that the Mao branch were supposed to be fast, but... this is...
虽然听说过卯很快……但这也……

Did you really think you could outrun a hare? Foolish.
竟然以为能用那么慢的步伐从兔子身边逃走……真是愚蠢。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
The thief had snatched a rather important shipment as it was en route to the child's lord.
从半路截走主公本应收到的重要物品，然后消失的小偷。

She received the command to capture the thief a whole two hours after he'd already made off with the shipment, but...
尽管小偷逃跑两个小时后，孩子才接收到抓捕小偷的命令……

... it took her less than thirty minutes to catch up to him.
但这时间差就好像没有意义一般，孩子只用不到半个小时便追上了他。

The Backstreets of Hongyuan teems with a chaotic jumble of buildings, but to a Heishou like herself—who roamed its alleys nightly and fought in every corner of the District—it was easy to anticipate the thief’s escape route.
虽然鸿园的后巷因为各种建筑而错综复杂，但对于每天都以鸿园为舞台展开暗斗的黑兽来说，应该已经对他的逃跑路线了如指掌了吧。

I see that the Anamnaworm is still intact.
“虫”没事吧。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
There was a long and fat worm-like creature writhing in the thief's palm.
小偷手里蠕动着一条又长又肥的虫子。

It was a truly hideous thing, its surface slick and its body wriggling in an unnatural and unpleasant motion... but that wasn't the worst of it.
尽管其光滑的表面、柔软的身躯不自然地蠕动的样子已经够恐怖的了……

The worst of it was its face.
但最可怕的，还属那个被称为“虫”的怪物的头部。

Its features are arranged like those of a human face—yet its sallow flesh hangs loose, its hollow eyes staring into the distant void. A monstrosity.
虽然长得和人类一模一样，但它的皮肤苍白松弛，凹陷的眼窝失去焦点，茫然地凝视着虚空，宛如一只恐怖的怪物。

Yet, the thief was holding this hideous thing as if it was the most precious thing in the world.
尽管如此，小偷还是小心翼翼地用双手环抱着它，好像那是一件珍贵的宝物。

I must cut off your head here and now for stealing an Anamnaworm made from a noble one...
偷了用贵人所制成的虫，就算立即将你斩首也不为过……
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
People from different regions, like the west or the south, might wonder what the purpose of this curious monstrosity might be...
在西部或南部等其他地区生活的人们看来，一条虫子能做什么……

... but an Anamnaworm wasn't like any other grub.
但这个小偷拿着的虫，和一般的虫子可不一样。

Anyone can gain the memories of the person who was used to make the grub by inserting it into their body,
这是一种特殊的虫子，放入体内后便能获得成为其材料之人的记忆，

and even once they have been mutated into this worm-like form, they are counted as people, not tools.
无论材料的贵贱，都会被认定为人而非物品的特殊的存在。

This particular Anamnaworm, currently held in the thief's palms, was created from someone of high prestige in Hongyuan with deep knowledge of the secrets of the family.
其中被小偷偷走的虫，是以知晓家族诸多秘辛的鸿园的尊贵人物为材料，炼制而成的贵重物品。

Various familial secrets of the lord were preserved within it in the form of a memory...
里面会以记忆的形式，记录着与孩子侍奉的主公相关的家族的各种信息……

So letting a hostile candidate from a rival family obtain this Anamnaworm would amount to giving them a significant intelligence advantage.
如果敌对家族的候选人把“虫”拿到手并放进自己体内，那么孩子的主公瞬间就会被夺走家族的各种秘密。

Explain what motivated you to steal the worm.
我想听听你贪图那只虫的理由。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
Despite the thief's grave crimes, the child decided to ask what drove him to steal the worm.
尽管如此，孩子还是决定与其直接砍掉小偷的头，不如问问情况。

Not out of pity, of course.
孩子并没有怀有同情心。

She was simply carrying out the will of her lord.
只是因为孩子的主公希望如此。

Perhaps the thief saw the slimmest chance for life through the child's cold, cold words?
是因为从孩子冷淡的语调中，领悟到了下达命令之人给予的机会吗？

He dropped to his knees and began to share a tearful tale of his own.
小偷立即跪下，用悲伤的声音开始讲述自己的故事。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I-I only needed some money, that's all.
只、只是因为我需要钱啊。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
O-one of the other families approached me first, offering me enough riches to live the rest of my life without concern as long as I brought this to them.
只、只要从其他家族那里拿到虫，就能得到一笔足够安稳生活一辈子的财富。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Please, I had no choice but to accept the offer. My mother is very sick, and, and with her old age—
为了照顾生病的老母亲，我别无选择……

You lie. Do you take me, a beast of a Heishou Pack, for a fool?
此乃谎言。要是黑兽连这个都察觉不到的话，怎么可能这么轻易就找到你。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
Your "sick and old" mother died three years ago.
生病的老母亲……哈。你老母早在三年前就没命了。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

???
？？？
dataList.content:
How do you already know so much about me...?
居然在那么短的时间里……

Now, the truth.
老实交代。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
My lord has given you a way out of this hole you've dug yourself into, but know that the path is extremely narrow.
主公伸给你的救命稻草可并不长。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
Should you lie any further...
如果无缘无故地说谎的话……
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
The thief hesitated for a long time, sensing that he was likely walking on very thin ice.
面对孩子坚决的态度，小偷犹豫了半天才开口。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
I... I was tired and scared of waiting for the Restructuring Days to come. That I might tumble down a hole I could never come back from.
我再也不想成天提心吊胆，担心自己什么时候会被重构日淘汰了。

The buildings within Hongyuan shift after every set interval.
存在于鸿园的大部分建筑，每隔一段时间就会移动一次。

The process is called 'restructuring', a redistribution of living spaces based on each individual's net worth.
那是根据各自所拥有的财产，重新分配空间的过程。

The poor are fated to live in their ever-shrinking homes, feeling unsafe even where they should feel the safest.
穷人居住的空间会越来越小，在本应成为休息场所的家里也无法安心休息。

It is unfortunate, yes... but to the child, a beast of a Heishou Pack, it mattered very little.
虽说是令人惋惜的处境……但对于作为黑兽的孩子来说，这个故事并不能引起她的共鸣。

So it was greed, after all.
是因为财迷心窍才这么做的吗。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
If that's all there was to it, then... we have nothing more to discuss.
如果是这种程度的话……我们要聊的话题就到此为止了。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

???
？？？
dataList.content:
T-take a single step, or if I see signs of your heels transforming... I'm inserting the Anamnaworm into my ear!
如、如果你靠近我，或者让我看到你的脚有变形的迹象的话……我就马上把这个虫放进自己的耳朵里！

... You must have a death wish. Those memories aren't for the faint of heart. Besides—
……急着送死吗。这不是你能承受的记忆。何况……
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

???
？？？
dataList.content:
W-wait, stop!!!
等、等一下！！！

No, we've talked enough.
不。没必要再说了。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
The sword hanging from the child's back began to shimmer with a sinister glow.
小偷还没说完，孩子背上的剑就开始闪烁起凶恶的光芒。

The glyphs were inscribed onto the sword using Q Corp.'s technology, and they activate and bestow power when a specific trigger is met.
用Q公司的技术刻在这柄剑上的奇异文字，只有在满足特定条件时才能发挥真正的力量。

And for this mission, the condition was... the Anamnaworm thief refusing her lord's mercy.
在这次任务中，孩子能使用这份力量的条件，是偷走“虫”的人拒绝了主公的仁慈。

The child unsheathes her sword as her feet begin to crack and twist, transforming into digitigrade limbs—strikingly similar to those of a hare. Standing on her toes alone, she braces to lunge at the thief.
拿着剑的孩子的脚，瞬间变成了像兔子一样的逆关节，做好了冲向小偷的准备……

At this point, he realizes that his efforts were most likely for nothing. But as a last ditch effort, he leaped backward, and—
预感到未来的小偷尽管明知是徒劳，却仍用尽全力地向后倒去。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Agh... Dammit!
咳呃呃……妈的！

—hurriedly shoved the Anamnaworm into his ear.
作为最后的手段，小偷慌忙将虫放进了耳朵里……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Guhhh...
咯啊……

You can try inserting the Anamnaworm into your body... but I can get it back fully intact as long as I cut you down immediately.
即使把虫放入体内，如果立即死亡的话……在体内的虫被同化之前，都可以完好无损地重新取出。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
You seem to have missed that part.
你忽略了这一点。
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
The child, who leaped forward in an explosive burst of speed, had killed the thief before he even had a chance to let out his final cry.
孩子的剑冲出得太快，小偷半声惨叫噎在喉头时便丧命了。

Normally, if one lingers too much after inserting the Anamnaworm into their body, the grub would assimilate with the host, unable to be removed until the conditions prescribed upon its creation are met...
再过一会儿，“虫”就会和小偷的身体融为一体……在满足制作“虫”时刻下的条件之前，用任何手段都无法取出……

... But the child managed to retrieve it without much trouble by killing the thief before the assimilation began.
既然在被同化之前取了命，孩子就可以轻松地找回虫了。

My next mission...
下一个任务是……
dataList.title:
Heishou Pack - Mao Branch
黑兽 - 卯

dataList.content:
The night is yet young for the child. There were more missions for her on the horizon.
但是孩子的夜晚并不是一个任务就能结束的。

To live in Hongyuan is to be mired in a constant vortex of dark conspiracies and battles. And as a beast of a Heishou Pack, the child...
鸿园之中暗流涌动，在暗斗旋涡的中心，身为黑兽的孩子……

... would have no rest and continue to hop between mission after mission bestowed upon her by her lord.
定会向主公新令所指的方向蹦跳下去。
